finding: Shopify Next Gen Events is generally available in API 2026-10 across 18 topics and supports actions, field-level triggers, query filters, and custom GraphQL payload queries.
old_approach: Broad webhook or follow-up reads can require extra calls and inference to identify the exact commerce change.
new_rule: NEXT_GEN_EVENTS_PRODUCT_SIGNAL_GATE: when authorized store event access exists, prefer narrowly filtered Next Gen Events for product/collection/order freshness signals; never treat event delivery itself as proof of demand or sales. Confirm sales with verified orders/net units/net sales before changing product ranking.
test_metric: On authorized store access, compare event payload read-back, follow-up call count, and false-positive product-ranking changes against existing method.
failure_fallback: Canonical ledger update was blocked; staged in knowledge/ only. If Events is unavailable, retain existing authorized reads/webhooks and mark freshness unknown; no blind retry.
